items.prompt: A library EMA disagrees with the worked recursive path. What should you check first?

options.text: Assume the library is broken for every input
options.why: Different declared algorithms can produce different correct results.

options.text: Delete the mismatch without recording its cause
Ignore initialization because it can never affect early outputs
options.why: Initialization directly affects the recursive path.

options.text: Compare alpha, initialization, adjust and missing-data rules
options.why: The shared name EMA does not establish matching contracts.

items.explanation: Compare algorithm and information-set contracts before treating different outputs as implementation errors.
